title: Twin Wake
summary: Start: enter Twin Wake. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. Two clans. The black sail is the other body. Pick a side by being here. Both will remember. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Red Sail's shell. Black Sail heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
